title: Greetings, Classroom Language and Parts of Speech

vocabulary.note_en: You can say it at any time. Answer with hello or hi.

fine_lines.title: good evening vs good night
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good evening تحية عند اللقاء في المساء (مساء الخير). good night لا تُقال عند اللقاء، بل عند الذهاب للنوم أو المغادرة ليلًا (تصبح على خير).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Good evening is a greeting when you meet someone in the evening. Good night is not a greeting; you say it before you go to bed or when you leave at night.

examples.sentence: Good night, Mom. I'm going to bed.

fine_lines.title: like vs love
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى يحب، لكن love أقوى بكثير من like. like = يحب أو يعجبه الشيء، love = يحب جدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both show a good feeling, but love is much stronger than like.

fine_lines.title: noun vs verb
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاسم (noun) هو اسم شخص أو حيوان أو شيء أو مكان. الفعل (verb) هو شيء نفعله أو نشعر به. اسأل نفسك: هل هناك شيء اسمه هكذا؟ إذن هو اسم. هل هو عمل أو إحساس؟ إذن هو فعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A noun is the name of a person, animal, thing or place. A verb is something we do or feel. Ask: is it a name? Then it is a noun. Is it an action or a feeling? Then it is a verb.

examples.sentence: Tiger, Cairo and pencil are nouns.
Play, read and love are verbs.

fine_lines.title: hello vs hi
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى أهلًا ويُقالان في أي وقت. hi أقصر وأكثر ودية وغير رسمية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the same and work at any time of day. Hi is shorter and more informal.

expressions.meaning_en: Put your hand up (to ask or answer in class).
expressions.example: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

expressions.meaning_en: Open the book that you have.
expressions.example: Open your book at page ten.

expressions.meaning_en: Shut the book that you have.
expressions.example: Close your book, please. It's time for the test.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask someone to stand.
expressions.example: Stand up, please, and say your name.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask someone to sit.
expressions.example: Thank you, Ali. Sit down, please.

expressions.meaning_en: A morning greeting to your teacher.
expressions.example: Good morning, teacher. Good morning, class.

grammar.title: Answering a greeting
grammar.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية نرد على التحية بنفس التحية غالبًا: إذا قال لك أحد Good morning فقل Good morning. ومع hello يمكن الرد بـ hello أو hi. ويمكن وضع علامة تعجب (!) بعد التحية عندما نقولها بحماس.
grammar.explanation_en: In English we usually answer a greeting with the same greeting. If someone says "Good morning", say "Good morning". You can answer "Hello" with "Hello" or "Hi". We often put an exclamation mark (!) after a warm greeting.
examples: A: Good afternoon! B: Good afternoon!

grammar.title: Greetings and the time of day
grammar.explanation_ar: hello و hi في أي وقت. good morning في الصباح، good afternoon بعد الظهر، good evening في المساء. good night قبل النوم، و goodbye عند المغادرة.
grammar.explanation_en: Hello and hi: any time. Good morning: morning. Good afternoon: after midday. Good evening: evening. Good night: before bed. Goodbye: when you leave.

grammar.title: Parts of speech: nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: الكلمة في الإنجليزية لها أنواع (parts of speech). أهمها الاسم noun: وهو اسم لشخص (person) مثل Ali، أو حيوان (animal) مثل tiger، أو شيء (thing) مثل pencil، أو مكان (place) مثل Cairo و school. أسماء المدن والأشخاص تبدأ بحرف كبير.
grammar.explanation_en: Words have types (parts of speech). A noun is the name of a person (Ali), an animal (tiger), a thing (pencil) or a place (Cairo, school). Names of people and cities start with a capital letter.
examples: place: Cairo, a school, an airport

grammar.title: Parts of speech: verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل verb كلمة تعبر عن عمل نقوم به مثل read و write و eat و play، أو عن إحساس مثل love و like و hate. لا يوجد شخص أو شيء اسمه «يلعب»، لذلك play فعل وليست اسمًا.
grammar.explanation_en: A verb is a word for an action (read, write, eat, play) or a feeling (love, like, hate). Nothing is called "play", so play is a verb, not a noun.

questions.question: What do you say to someone at 8 o'clock in the morning?
questions.explanation_en: In the morning we say good morning.

questions.question: Your friend says "Good afternoon!" What is the best answer?
questions.explanation_en: We answer a greeting with the same greeting.

questions.question: You are going to bed. What do you say to your family?
questions.explanation_ar: قبل النوم نقول Good night = تصبح على خير.
questions.explanation_en: Before bed we say good night.

questions.question: Which greeting can you say at any time of day?
The teacher says "Raise your hand." What do you do?
questions.explanation_en: Raise your hand means put your hand up.

questions.question: "Sit down" means ...
questions.explanation_ar: sit down = اجلس، و stand up = قف.
questions.explanation_en: Sit down means go to a sitting position.

questions.question: Which word is a verb?
questions.explanation_ar: write = يكتب، وهو عمل نقوم به، إذن فعل.
questions.explanation_en: Write is an action, so it is a verb.

questions.question: "Cairo" is the name of a ...
questions.explanation_en: Cairo is a city, so it is a place.

questions.question: Which word is a noun for an animal?
questions.explanation_en: An owl is a bird, so it is an animal.

questions.question: Which word means "like very much"?
questions.explanation_ar: love أقوى من like في الحب.
